idle.reason: Stable naturally standing recovery, same source identity as the selected run. Excludes the blink that turns directly into celebration.
limitations: Nearly static idle; no complete natural blink in this interval. Endpoint continuity still requires final matte/render review.

walk.reason: Complete right-and-left step cycle with relaxed arms, a low ranked boundary mismatch, and no omitted/interpolated source frames.
limitations: Brisk walk: full cycle is 0.75s. User previously found this source somewhat stiff; retain as candidate rather than claim visual acceptance. Source head/body shape differs slightly from 1885 after constant scaling.

run.reason: Complete two-step gait: passes support/recovery for both legs and both opposite arm swings; 18 consecutive original frames at24fps. f150 matches f132 phase well.
limitations: Original video shading and small hand/foot shape changes remain. No promise of physically correct world-displacement speed.

jump.reason: First complete takeoff-flight-landing passage only. Starts during visible anticipatory crouch, lands and recovers to brief near-upright f233 before the next jump begins at f234.
limitations: The source enters crouch from running, not from neutral idle. End f233 has arms bent, not relaxed neutral idle. No missing neutral transition frames have been invented. Must be labelled one-shot crouch-jump candidate; idle-to-jump and jump-to-idle can still pop. Facial view/volume shift during the jump is retained.

celebrate.reason: Full original celebration onset and return to relaxed standing, preserving its real number of gestures and timing.
limitations: More than two fist raises and hands reach the ears. One-shot, not a seamless cycle. This is optional for this review batch.

walk.reason: More leisurely full walking cycle, 22frames/0.917s; both opposite arm and leg phases are present.
limitations: Cross-cycle pose variation is larger than2067 candidate; ankles differ slightly around wrap. Face/neck drawing differs from1885 source.

run.reason: Same18frame full gait starting at an airborne extension phase.
limitations: Prefer support-phase start132 for action switching; this alternate demonstrates start-phase choice.

jump.reason: Single original run-jump with a complete landing recovery to relaxed standing byf228–231.
limitations: Single-leg takeoff directly from running; cannot be called standing two-foot jump. Has faint landing dust and slightly blurred moving edges.

diagnosticMethod: Lower-body fixed-screen silhouette/RGB differences. Five-frame neighborhoods identify phase; seam step is last->first relative to mean normal adjacent step. Full limb cycles were additionally inspected in contact sheets. Numbers are diagnostics, not art scores.
rootCaveat: Cross-source consistency must be checked after constant registration; do not force face/body matching via per-frame transforms, morphing, repainting or crossfades.
noteScope: Selection analysis; temporary source-comparison paths omitted. Final export contract is artwork/kling-side-selection/selection.json.
